description: This header provides utility functions for file synchronization and JSON settings persistence, including functions to sync a file to disk and to persist JSON settings to a file within the Utils namespace.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the specified file to disk by opening it, flushing buffers, and calling fsync.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON value under a specific key to a file, ensuring the settings are saved and synchronized to disk.

ctags.name: persistJsonSettings
ctags.pattern: /^inline void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile, const string strKey, const JsonValue& jsVa/
ctags.signature: (const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
